v.story-vce.intro.1.text: Silent-E Forest is thick with tall trees, and many of its words end with a quiet e.

v.story-vce.intro.2.text: That e makes no sound itself, but it tells the vowel before it to say its own name.

v.story-vce.intro.3.text: Find the torn pages in the forest, and listen for the vowels that say their names.

v.story-vce.vce-one.1.text: A cake sits on a log, and the silent e at its end tells the a to say its name.

v.story-vce.vce-one.2.text: Hear the long vowel, let the e stay quiet, and the page slides out of the bramble.

v.story-vce.vce-soft.1.text: A page by the lake has a soft c and a soft g, and their sounds change before e or i.

v.story-vce.vce-soft.2.text: Hear c go soft like s, and g go soft like j, and the words open up for you.

v.story-vce.vce-two.1.text: A long word in the forest has two parts, and the silent e helps you find the split.

v.story-vce.vce-two.2.text: Say the first part with its long vowel, then the second part, and join them smoothly.

v.story-vce.vce-mix.1.text: The deepest part of the forest hides a long word with three parts and several silent e's.

v.story-vce.vce-mix.2.text: Read each part with its vowel, check each silent e, and the whole path opens up.

v.story-vce.finale.1.text: The silent e's stayed quiet, but they did the work, and the forest pages are back.

v.story-vce.finale.2.text: The Keeper nods and says, 'Vowel Team Harbor is next, where two vowels work together.'
